description: This file is a shell script for system diagnostics, managing LED indicators based on system state during boot and startup procedures in an embedded Linux environment (OpenWrt). It defines functions to determine the status LED based on the board type and to set the LED state according to different phases (preinit, failsafe, done).

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines the appropriate status LED based on the board name.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on system startup phase input.
